hooks.command: shopt -s nocasematch; input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"tool_name":"WebFetch"'*) case "$input" in *',"agent_id":"'*) case "$input" in *',"agent_type":"web-fetch"'*) ;; *) echo 'PathWise lockdown: helper agents have no internet.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac ;; esac; no() { echo 'PathWise lockdown: only HGNC and UniProt name lookups are allowed.' >&2; exit 2; }; url=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"url":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); case "$url" in ''|*[[:space:]]*|*'@'*|*'\'*|*'..'*) no ;; esac; bad=$(printf '%s' "$url" | grep -oi '%..' | grep -viE '^%(2[0289c]|3a)$'); [ -z "$bad" ] || no; case "$url" in 'https://rest.genenames.org/info'|'https://rest.genenames.org/fetch/'*|'https://rest.genenames.org/search/'*) exit 0 ;; 'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?'*) printf '%s' "$url" | grep -q 'format=tsv' || no; [ -z "$(printf '%s' "$url" | grep -oi 'format=[^&#]*' | grep -v '^format=tsv$')" ] || no; fl=$(printf '%s' "$url" | grep -oi 'fields=[^&#]*'); [ -n "$fl" ] || no; shopt -u nocasematch; while IFS= read -r x; do case "$x" in 'fields='*) ;; *) no ;; esac; for v in $(printf '%s' "${x#fields=}" | sed 's/%2[cC]/ /g; s/,/ /g'); do case "$v" in accession|id|gene_primary|gene_synonym|protein_name|organism_name|reviewed) ;; *) no ;; esac; done; done <<< "$fl"; exit 0 ;; esac; no ;; esac; case "$input" in *',"agent_id":"'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$input" in *'"tool_name":"Read"'*) case "$input" in *pathwise_output*|*'~'*) echo 'PathWise lockdown: helper agents cannot read run results.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0 ;; *'"tool_name":"Write"'*) fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"file_path":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | tr '\' '/'); case "$fp" in *..*|*'~'*) echo 'PathWise lockdown: invalid result path.' >&2; exit 2 ;; */pathwise_output*/articles/*) exit 0 ;; esac; echo 'PathWise lockdown: helper agents can only write their own result files.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; echo 'PathWise lockdown: helper agents can only read files and write their own result files.' >&2; exit 2
